question_text:
Read the following statements:
a)
Shanmuganathan is appointed as Governor of Meghalaya
b)
Draupadi Murmu is appointed as Governor of Jharkhand
c)
Tathagata Roy is appointed as Governor of Arunachal Pradesh
d)
Najma Heptullah is appointed as Governor of Mizoram

a)

b)

c)

d)

Choose the correct statements :
